title: Total requests per second
intro: Your manager asks one question: how much traffic are we serving right now, across everything?

objectives.text: Show total requests per second across all services

hints: Counters only go up. rate() turns them into per-second values.
debrief: sum(rate(counter[5m])) is the most common PromQL query there is. Remember: rate first, then sum, never the other way round.
